data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: openrocket
ui_devex.summary: OpenRocket是一款开源模型火箭飞行模拟软件，通过精确的物理引擎计算空气动力学、稳定性和弹道轨迹，帮助用户在设计阶段预测火箭性能。它采用实时仿真技术，整合了风阻、发动机参数等变量，使模拟结果高度可靠。用户可通过拖拽组件构建虚拟火箭，运行模拟以优化设计，并导出数据进行分析，适用于教学演示或业余爱好者测试新创意，降低实际发射的风险与成本。
ui_devex.summary_en: OpenRocket is a free, open-source software for simulating model rocket flights, helping enthusiasts and students design and test rockets safely before launch. It uses advanced physics engines to calculate aerodynamics, stability, and trajectory in real-time, incorporating factors like wind and motor performance. Users can build virtual rockets with drag-and-drop components, run simulations to optimize designs, and export data for analysis, making it ideal for educational projects or hobbyist experimentation.

agents_workflows.name: TradingAgents
agents_workflows.summary: TradingAgents是一个开源的多智能体金融交易框架，通过协调多个AI代理实现自动化市场分析和交易决策，解决了单一模型处理复杂金融数据的局限性。其核心技术在于利用大语言模型解析市场信息，让不同专业代理分工协作，形成更稳健的交易策略。用户可基于该框架定制交易逻辑，使用历史数据进行策略回测，并部署到实际交易环境中进行实验，适合开发者构建和测试自动化交易系统，探索AI在金融领域的应用潜力。
agents_workflows.summary_en: TradingAgents is an open-source framework that enables automated financial trading by coordinating multiple AI agents, addressing the complexity of real-time market analysis. Its technical innovation lies in using large language models to interpret market signals and execute coordinated strategies across specialized agents. Developers can implement custom trading logic, backtest strategies with historical data, and deploy the system for algorithmic trading experiments, making it practical for both research and prototyping automated trading systems.
